title: Jacobs records denied and mailbox blown up

plain: A researcher who studies UFOs around nuclear weapons, Robert Hastings, passes on a story he says he heard from Robert Jacobs, a man who served in the US Air Force. Hastings says that after Jacobs told his story, the Air Force denied there had ever been a Robert Jacobs in its ranks. Then one night, he says, Jacobs and his wife came home from a movie, the phone rang, and a voice said their mailbox was alight, "what a beautiful sight," and "you're going down." A podcast host, Jesse Michels, also names Jacobs as a photo instrumentation specialist at Vandenberg, an Air Force base in California, in 1964, though he doesn't go into the threats. If it's true, someone was working hard to frighten a witness into silence.
